annotation.summary: 武曲贪狼仅丑未同度，金木相克。任一化禄转作金制木而见正面作用，仍须多吉才减劳碌；任一化忌则负面显现，即使多吉也劳碌起伏。会煞多不见吉的作用近化忌，不可混同实际化忌。
annotation.summary_en: Wu Qu and Tan Lang share Chou or Wei and are described as metal–wood conflict. Hua Lu on either star changes the account to constructive control, yet many benefics are still needed to reduce toil. Hua Ji on either brings adversity and fluctuations even with benefics. Many malefics without benefics are compared with Hua Ji in effect, not asserted to be an actual transformation.

Wu Qu’s inward metal symbolism is associated with narrowness and stinginess. Conflict plus malefic opposition raises health concerns, but short life cannot be inferred automatically. Palace strength and benefic/malefic conditions remain decisive; a damaged ancient quotation is excluded.

usable_spans.quote:
[上下文] 《紫雲論斗數星曜賦性》第二冊，武曲；武貪負面作用與不可遽斷壽命。
---
從上述解說就可知道，當武貪在丑未坐命者，若其中任一星曜化忌，或者在會煞多而不會吉時，此二星曜的負面賦性作用就會被彰顯出來，此時不但不利於財，亦不利於親情與人際關係。再者，武曲因五行屬金，金主「内聚」，在遇有化忌或會煞多時，其人往往不但氣量狹小，且亦較吝嗇。更有甚者，因命宮星曜相剋者，除遇事較無法心平氣和外，此時若再有煞星來沖，也較易有健康上的問題。因此，對一個不能心平氣和來面對事情，且健康又較易有問題的人，雖不能據此推論此人一定會短命，但恐怕也不易長壽。另外，在天機星部份曾提及，凡星曜五行屬木者，在會多吉星時，其人會較長壽，而貪狼五行屬木，被金剋害後，反不利於此，
但武貪在丑未坐命者，是否就會如先賢或賦文所言，則仍須視此二宮位的旺弱吉凶而定。

annotation.summary: 辰戌丑未为四墓库，武曲在其中旺；丑未同贪狼、辰戌对宫贪狼。火星与贪狼同宫且会吉方论火贪成格，铃星替代同理。大富贵还受社会环境影响；命宫同太岁是吉凶皆加重，非四库年支一概有利。
annotation.summary_en: Chen, Xu, Chou and Wei are described as the four repositories where Wu Qu is strong. Tan Lang shares Chou/Wei and opposes Chen/Xu. Huo Tan formation requires Huo Xing with Tan Lang and benefics; Ling Xing may substitute. Great wealth or status also depends on social environment. A Life Palace sharing the Tai Sui location amplifies both good and bad, not an unconditional benefit for repository-year births.

annotation.summary: 武贪丑命，己年武曲化禄贪狼化权，作者称命旺制羊陀，己丑同太岁更吉；癸年贪狼化忌与擎羊同踞则凶，癸丑同太岁更凶。命宫或大限同太岁会加强原吉凶，并非四库年支都利武曲。
annotation.summary_en: For Wu Qu–Tan Lang in Chou, the Ji-year example has Wu Qu Hua Lu and Tan Lang Hua Quan, with a strong Life Palace said to control Qing Yang/Tuo Luo. Ji Chou intensifies the favorable account through Tai Sui overlap. The Gui-year example has Tan Lang Hua Ji with Qing Yang; Gui Chou intensifies adversity. Life or major-period overlap with Tai Sui amplifies existing conditions rather than always benefiting repository-year births.

annotation.summary: 作者强调火贪大富贵须火星贪狼同宫。盘七武曲辰命同火星不同于此；除多吉且行限佳外，武曲、贪狼或廉贞任一化忌可能激发寡宿负面，而非一定富贵。
annotation.summary_en: The author distinguishes Huo Xing sharing Tan Lang from Chart Seven’s Wu Qu sharing Huo Xing in the Chen Life Palace. The latter is not an automatic Huo Tan wealth configuration. Unless many benefics and favorable fortune periods intervene, Hua Ji on Wu Qu, Tan Lang or Lian Zhen can activate the adverse Gu Su account rather than produce great wealth or status.
